/* Desktop Events Grid Layout - Image-based cards like featured section */
.desktopEventsGrid {
  display: none; /* Hidden by default, shown only on desktop */
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 clamp(15px, 2vw, 30px); /* Responsive padding */
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: clamp(30px, 3vw, 60px); /* Responsive gap */
  margin-top: 80px;
  position: relative;
  top: -11vh; /* Move the entire section up closer to heading (5% more) */
}

.desktopEventCard {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: clamp(350px, 25vw, 450px); /* Responsive height based on viewport width */
  background: transparent;
}

.desktopEventImageContainer {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: clamp(280px, 20vw, 370px); /* Responsive height based on viewport width */
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #f5f5f5;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.35), 0 6px 16px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.20);
  transition: box-shadow 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
}

.desktopEventImage {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.desktopEventImageContainer:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 28px 70px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.45), 0 10px 24px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.26);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.desktopEventImageContainer:hover .desktopEventImage {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.desktopEventNoImageContainer {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: clamp(280px, 20vw, 370px); /* Responsive height based on viewport width */
  background: #f5f5f5;
  border-radius: 10px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border: 2px dashed #ccc;
}

.desktopEventNoImageText {
  font-family: 'PP Editorial New', serif;
  font-size: clamp(18px, 1.5vw, 24px); /* Responsive font size */
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #666;
  text-align: center;
  padding: clamp(15px, 1.5vw, 20px); /* Responsive padding */
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.desktopEventOverlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.desktopEventCard:hover .desktopEventOverlay {
  opacity: 1;
}

.desktopEventArrow {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate(-15px, 10px);
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease;
  visibility: hidden;
}

.desktopEventCard:hover .desktopEventArrow {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(0, 0);
  visibility: visible;
}

.desktopArrowIcon {
  width: clamp(80px, 8vw, 160px); /* Responsive arrow size */
  height: clamp(80px, 8vw, 160px);
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
}

.desktopEventTitle {
  font-family: 'PP Editorial New', serif;
  font-size: clamp(24px, 2vw, 36px); /* Responsive title font size */
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #000;
  text-align: left;
  margin-top: clamp(15px, 1.5vw, 20px); /* Responsive margin */
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.desktopEventLink {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* Mobile Events List - Hidden on desktop */
.mobileEventsList {
  display: block;
}

/* Mobile and Tablet - Hide desktop grid completely */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .desktopEventsGrid {
    display: none !important;
  }
  
  .mobileEventsList {
    display: block;
  }
}

/* Desktop-only styles */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .desktopEventsGrid {
    display: grid;
  }
  
  .mobileEventsList {
    display: none;
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) {
    /* First event in each row - larger image */
    height: clamp(380px, 27vw, 480px); /* Responsive height */
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) .desktopEventImageContainer,
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) .desktopEventNoImageContainer {
    height: clamp(300px, 22vw, 400px); /* Responsive height */
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) {
    /* Second event in each row - smaller image */
    height: clamp(300px, 22vw, 380px); /* Responsive height */
    margin-top: 0px; /* Reduced offset to align image borders horizontally */
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) .desktopEventImageContainer,
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) .desktopEventNoImageContainer {
    height: clamp(240px, 18vw, 300px); /* Responsive height */
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) .desktopEventTitle {
    font-size: clamp(28px, 2.3vw, 40px); /* Responsive font size */
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) .desktopEventTitle {
    font-size: clamp(22px, 1.8vw, 32px); /* Responsive font size */
  }
}

/* Extra large screens */
@media (min-width: 1440px) {
  .events {
    --menu-item-height: 160px; /* keep consistent height even on large screens */
    height: auto; /* Changed from fixed calculation to auto */
    min-height: 120vh; /* Increased minimum height for extra large screens */
    font-size: 120px;
  }
  
  .mobileNavBrand {
    left: 25px;
  }
  .brandLine1,
  .brandLine2 {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  
  .events2 {
    font-size: 120px; /* original large screen size */
    top: 75px; /* added 15px to original 60px for large screens */
    left: 3.39%; /* 65px / 1920px = 3.39% for large screens */
    height: 80px;
  }
  
  .searchContainer {
    width: 50%;
    height: 60px;
    top: 110vh; /* viewport-based - converted from calc(100vh + 80px) */
    right: 1.04%; /* percentage-based positioning for large screens */
  }
  
  .searchInput {
    font-size: 30px;
  }
  
  .magnifyingGlassSvgrepoCom1Icon {
    width: 35px;
    height: 35px;
  }
  
  .eventsItem {
    top: 255px; /* added 15px to align with new Events title position */
    left: 80px;
    right: 80px;
  }
  
  .eventsList {
    position: relative; /* Changed from absolute to relative */
    margin-top: 16%; /* Increased space for extra large screens */
    padding: 0 20px;
  }
  
  .desktopEventsGrid {
    max-width: 1400px;
    gap: 60px;
    margin-top: 100px;
    top: -15vh; /* Move the entire section up more on large screens (5% more) */
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) {
    height: 500px;
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) .desktopEventImageContainer,
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) .desktopEventNoImageContainer {
    height: 420px;
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) {
    height: 400px;
    margin-top: 0px; /* Reduced offset to align image borders horizontally */
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) .desktopEventImageContainer,
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) .desktopEventNoImageContainer {
    height: 320px;
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(odd) .desktopEventTitle {
    font-size: 40px;
  }
  
  .desktopEventCard:nth-child(even) .desktopEventTitle {
    font-size: 32px;
  }
  
  /* Ultra-wide: scale desktop hover arrow up further */
  .desktopArrowIcon {
    width: 200px;
    height: 200px;
  }
}

/* Loading and Error States */
.loadingContainer,
.errorContainer,
.noEventsContainer {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  text-align: center;
  z-index: 10;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  padding: 40px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}

.loadingContainer p,
.errorContainer p,
.noEventsContainer p {
  font-size: 24px;
  color: #333;
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.spinner {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border: 4px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  border-top: 4px solid #007bff;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
  margin: 0 auto 20px;
}

@keyframes spin {
  0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

.errorContainer {
  background: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.1);
  border-color: rgba(220, 53, 69, 0.3);
}

.errorContainer p {
  color: #dc3545;
}

.noEventsContainer {
  background: rgba(108, 117, 125, 0.1);
  border-color: rgba(108, 117, 125, 0.3);
}

.noEventsContainer p {
  color: #6c757d;
}

/* Responsive adjustments for loading states */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .loadingContainer,
  .errorContainer,
  .noEventsContainer {
    padding: 20px;
    margin: 0 20px;
    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    width: calc(100% - 40px);
    max-width: 400px;
  }
  
  .loadingContainer p,
  .errorContainer p,
  .noEventsContainer p {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  
  .spinner {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    border-width: 3px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  /* Mobile-only text-box line: use border on the text box itself */
  .smallTextBox1 {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #666; /* darker than #ddd */
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    color: #666; /* match desktop small text color */
  }
  .smallTextBox2 {
    border-bottom: 1px solid #666; /* apply same line under second text */
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    color: #666; /* match desktop small text color */
  }
  /* Switch to flow layout so spacing changes actually apply on mobile */
  .img2024101415521735Parent .smallTextBox1,
  .img2024101415521735Parent .smallTextBox2 {
    position: relative !important;
    top: auto !important;
    left: auto !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    margin-top: 6px; /* tighter gap under titles */
    z-index: 3;
  }
  /* Disable previous pseudo-element line */
  .smallTextBox1::after {
    content: none !important;
  }
}

/* Animated lines below titles and descriptions - similar to contact page */
.textBox1 {
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
}

.textBox1::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: #666;
  transform-origin: left center;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  animation: cu-lineGrow 800ms ease-out forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 200ms);
}

.textBox1Second {
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  z-index: 3; /* keep title and its underline above images */
}

.textBox1Second::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: #000;
  transform-origin: left center;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  animation: cu-lineGrow 800ms ease-out forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 220ms);
}

.textBox2 {
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}

.textBox2::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: #666;
  transform-origin: left center;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  animation: cu-lineGrow 800ms ease-out forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 240ms);
}

.textBox2Second {
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 6px;
}

.textBox2Second::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: #666;
  transform-origin: left center;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  animation: cu-lineGrow 800ms ease-out forwards;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 260ms);
}

/* Tablet: match textBox1Second to textBox1 */
.textBox1Second {
  font-family: 'PP Editorial New', serif;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .textBox1Second {
    font-size: 48px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #000;
    text-align: left;
    margin: -8px 0 0px 0; /* reduced spacing - changed from 2px to -8px */
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
    animation: cu-textReveal 600ms ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 100ms);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .textBox1Second {
    font-size: 36px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #000;
    text-align: left;
    margin: -10px 0 0px 0; /* reduced spacing - changed from 2px to -10px */
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
    animation: cu-textReveal 600ms ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 100ms);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .textBox1Second {
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #000;
    text-align: left;
    margin: -8px 0 0px 0; /* reduced spacing - changed from 1px to -8px */
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
    animation: cu-textReveal 600ms ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 100ms);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .textBox1Second {
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #000;
    text-align: left;
    margin: -6px 0 0px 0; /* reduced spacing - changed from 1px to -6px */
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
    animation: cu-textReveal 600ms ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--cu-delay-base) + 100ms);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  /* Hide small description boxes on mobile */
  .smallTextBox1,
  .smallTextBox2 {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  /* Increase vertical spacing between featured images */
  .img2024101415521735Parent {
    gap: 24px; /* was smaller; increase spacing between stacked images */
  }
  .img2024101415521735Parent .img2024101415521736Icon {
    margin-top: 20px; /* was 14px; extra space between first title area and second image */
  }
}

/* Increase desktop word spacing for titles and descriptions */
.textBox1,
.textBox1Second,
.textBox2,
.textBox2Second {
  word-spacing: 0.1em;
}

/* Featured Image Hover Overlay Styles */
.featuredImageLink {
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
}

/* Base container styles */
.featuredImageContainer {
  position: absolute;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.35), 0 6px 16px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.20);
  transition: box-shadow 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
}

/* Container for first featured image - matches original img2024101415521735Icon positioning */
.featuredImageContainer1 {
  top: 7%;
  left: 58%;
  width: 32%;
  height: 52%;
}

/* Container for second featured image - matches original img2024101415521736Icon positioning */
.featuredImageContainer2 {
  top: 7%;
  left: 4%;
  width: 40%;
  height: 64%;
}

.featuredImageOverlay {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 1s ease-out;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.featuredImageArrow {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate(-15px, 10px);
  transition: opacity 1s ease-out, transform 1s ease-out;
  visibility: hidden;
}

.arrowIcon {
  width: 160px;
  height: 160px;
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1); /* Make arrow white */
}

/* Hover states for featured images */
.featuredImageLink:hover .featuredImageOverlay {
  opacity: 1;
}

.featuredImageLink:hover .featuredImageContainer {
  box-shadow: 0 28px 70px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.45), 0 10px 24px rgba(110, 70, 30, 0.26);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.featuredImageLink:hover .featuredImageArrow {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(0, 0);
  visibility: visible;
}

/* Mobile responsive adjustments for hover overlay */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .arrowIcon {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
  }
  
  .featuredImageOverlay {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); /* Lighter overlay on mobile */
  }
  
  /* Revert containers to relative positioning on mobile */
  .featuredImageContainer,
  .featuredImageContainer1,
  .featuredImageContainer2 {
    position: relative !important;
    top: auto !important;
    left: auto !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .arrowIcon {
  	width: 50px;
  	height: 50px;
  }
  
  .featuredImageOverlay {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25); /* Even lighter overlay on small mobile */
  }
  
  /* Ensure containers stay relative on small mobile */
  .featuredImageContainer,
  .featuredImageContainer1,
  .featuredImageContainer2 {
    position: relative !important;
    top: auto !important;
    left: auto !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
  }
}
