<file src="src/lib/uploadImage.js">
import { supabase } from './supabaseClient'
import exifr from 'exifr'

export async function uploadImage(file, { title, isPublic = true } = {}) {
  if (!file) throw new Error('No file provided')

  const { data: auth } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
  const userId = auth?.user?.id || null
  const userEmail = auth?.user?.email || ''

  // Ensure a profile row exists to satisfy FK (images.uploaded_by -> users.id)
  if (userId) {
    const username = userEmail ? userEmail.split('@')[0] : null
    await supabase
      .from('users')
      .upsert({ id: userId, username: username || userId, display_name: username || 'User' }, { onConflict: 'id' })
  }

  const extension = (file.name.split('.').pop() || 'jpg').toLowerCase()
  const datePrefix = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  const path = `uploads/${datePrefix}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${extension}`

  const { error: upErr } = await supabase.storage
    .from('images')
    .upload(path, file, {
      cacheControl: '3600',
      upsert: false,
      contentType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
    })
  if (upErr) throw upErr

  const { data: pub } = supabase.storage.from('images').getPublicUrl(path)
  const publicUrl = pub?.publicUrl

  // Extract EXIF (best-effort)
  let exif = null
  try {
    exif = await exifr.parse(file, { tiff: true, ifd0: true, exif: true, iptc: true })
  } catch {}

  // Normalize a few fields
  const toNumber = (v) => (typeof v === 'number' ? v : (v && v.numerator && v.denominator ? v.numerator / v.denominator : null))
  const aperture_fnumber = toNumber(exif?.FNumber) || toNumber(exif?.ApertureValue) || null
  const focal_length_mm = toNumber(exif?.FocalLength) || null
  const iso = (exif?.ISO && Number(exif.ISO)) || null
  const camera_make = exif?.Make || null
  const camera_model = exif?.Model || null
  const lens_model = exif?.LensModel || null
  const taken_at = exif?.DateTimeOriginal ? new Date(exif.DateTimeOriginal).toISOString() : null
  // Shutter speed as pretty fraction if possible
  let shutter_speed = null
  if (exif?.ExposureTime) {
    const v = toNumber(exif.ExposureTime)
    if (v && v > 0) {
      shutter_speed = v >= 1 ? `${v.toFixed(1)}s` : `1/${Math.round(1 / v)}`
    }
  } else if (exif?.ShutterSpeedValue) {
    const v = toNumber(exif.ShutterSpeedValue)
    if (v) shutter_speed = `${v.toFixed(2)}s`
  }

  const { data, error: insErr } = await supabase
    .from('images')
    .insert({
      storage_path: path,
      public_url: publicUrl,
      title: title || file.name,
      is_public: isPublic,
      uploaded_by: userId,
      exif_json: exif ? JSON.stringify(exif) : null,
      camera_make,
      camera_model,
      lens_model,
      focal_length_mm,
      aperture_fnumber,
      shutter_speed,
      iso,
      taken_at
    })
    .select()
    .single()

  if (insErr) throw insErr
  return data
}

export async function uploadImagesBatch(files, { isPublic = true } = {}, onProgress) {
  const results = []
  for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i += 1) {
    const file = files[i]
    const row = await uploadImage(file, { title: file.name, isPublic })
    results.push(row)
    if (typeof onProgress === 'function') onProgress({ index: i + 1, total: files.length })
  }
  return results
}

import { StrictMode } from 'react'
import './index.css'
// Initialize global ScrollTrigger defaults (smooth scrub without Lenis)
import './lib/scroll.ts'
import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'
import App from './App.jsx'
import { SpeedInsights } from "@vercel/speed-insights/react"
// Initialize performance monitoring
import { initPerformanceMonitoring } from './utils/performanceMonitor.js'
// Import deferred initialization utility
import { deferToIdle } from './utils/deferredInit.js'

// Hydrate root after main thread settles for a tick
const mount = () => {
  createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(
    <StrictMode>
      <App />
      <SpeedInsights />
    </StrictMode>,
  )
  
  // Defer non-critical initialization to idle time for better performance
  deferToIdle(() => {
    initPerformanceMonitoring()
  })
  
  // Disable image dragging globally
  document.addEventListener('dragstart', (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'IMG') {
      e.preventDefault()
      return false
    }
  }, { passive: false })
  
  // Prevent context menu on images to avoid "Open image in new tab"
  document.addEventListener('contextmenu', (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === 'IMG') {
      e.preventDefault()
      return false
    }
  }, { passive: false })
  
  // Remove boot cover ASAP after mount
  const cover = document.getElementById('boot-cover')
  if (cover) {
    // Use rAF to avoid layout jank and ensure React committed
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      cover.parentNode && cover.parentNode.removeChild(cover)
    })
  }
}

mount()

</file>

<file src="src/styles/Gallery.css">
/* Hide scrollbar for entire pictures page */
html, body {
  scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
  -ms-overflow-style: none; /* Internet Explorer 10+ */
}

html::-webkit-scrollbar, body::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none; /* Webkit browsers (Chrome, Safari, Edge) */
}

.gallery-container {
  font-family: 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Source Sans Pro', 'Open Sans', 'Nunito Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  background: #ede9e4;
  color: #222222;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
  position: relative;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  width: 100%;
  /* Hide scrollbar for Webkit browsers */
  scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
  -ms-overflow-style: none; /* Internet Explorer 10+ */
}

.gallery-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none; /* Webkit browsers (Chrome, Safari, Edge) */
}

/* Light gray left side background */
.gallery-container::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 50vw;
  height: 100vh;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* Desktop-only: Dynamic height for background */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .gallery-container::before {
    position: absolute;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }
}

/* Loading Page */
.c-loading-page {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: #F2EAE0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 2000;
  /* Match landing shutter timing feel: slower, smoother fade */
  transition: opacity 2.8s cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1);
  will-change: opacity;
}

.c-loading-page__content {
  text-align: center;
}

.c-loading-page__text {
  font-family: 'Inter', 'Roboto', 'Source Sans Pro', 'Open Sans', 'Nunito Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(36px, 8vw, 72px);
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  visibility: visible;
}

/* Per-letter animation for loading title */
.char {
  display: inline-block;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(20px);
  /* Slightly slower per-letter to align with longer overlay */
  animation: charIn 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
}

@keyframes charIn {
  from { 
    opacity: 0; 
    transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.8); 
  }
  to { 
    opacity: 1; 
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1); 
  }
}

/* Navigation Brand Text */
.mobileNavBrand {
  position: fixed;
  top: 15px;
  left: 15px;
  font-family: 'PP Editorial New', serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #000;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  z-index: 9999; /* Very high z-index to stay above navigation bar */
  display: block; /* Show by default on desktop */
  line-height: 1;
  pointer-events: auto; /* Allow hover interactions */
}

.brandLine1,
.brandLine2 {
  display: block;
  font-size: 16px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-family: 'PP Editorial New', serif;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.brandLine1:hover,
.brandLine2:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

/* Show on mobile versions only */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .mobileNavBrand {
    display: block;
    top: 18px;
    left: 18px;
  }
  .brandLine1,
  .brandLine2 {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  
  /* Add top margin to grid container to match navigation bar height */
  .p-home-grid-mode {
    margin-top: 60px;
    padding-top: 0; /* Override base padding on mobile */
  }
  
  /* Hide right side big image display on mobile */
  .p-home-right-component {
    display: none;
  }
  
  /* Make grid take full width on mobile since right component is hidden */
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

/* Mobile landscape */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .mobileNavBrand {
    top: 16px;
    left: 16px;
  }
  .brandLine1,
  .brandLine2 {
    font-size: 17px;
  }
  
  /* Adjust top margin for mobile landscape */
  .p-home-grid-mode {
    margin-top: 55px;
    padding-top: 0; /* Override base padding on mobile */
  }
}

/* Mobile portrait */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .mobileNavBrand {
    top: 14px;
    left: 14px;
  }
  .brandLine1,
  .brandLine2 {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
  
  /* Adjust top margin for mobile portrait */
  .p-home-grid-mode {
    margin-top: 50px;
    padding-top: 0; /* Override base padding on mobile */
  }
}

/* Small mobile devices */
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .mobileNavBrand {
    top: 12px;
    left: 12px;
  }
  .brandLine1,
  .brandLine2 {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  
  /* Adjust top margin for small mobile devices */
  .p-home-grid-mode {
    margin-top: 45px;
    padding-top: 0; /* Override base padding on mobile */
  }
}

/* Mobile-only Gallery Styles */
.gallery-mobile {
  background: #ede9e4;
  height: 100vh !important;
  overflow-y: auto;
  position: relative;
}

.gallery-mobile::before {
  display: none; /* Remove the left gray background on mobile */
}

.gallery-mobile .main {
  height: auto !important;
  min-height: auto !important;
}

.p-home-grid-mode-mobile {
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 0 15px;
  margin-top: 120px;
  padding-top: 0;
  height: auto;
  min-height: auto;
}

.p-home-left-section-mobile {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  min-height: auto !important;
  max-height: none !important;
}

.p-home-grid-mode__contents-mobile {
  width: 100% !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 20px 10px;
  margin-left: 0;
  justify-content: center;
}

/* Mobile responsive grid adjustments */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode-mobile {
    margin-top: 110px;
  }
  
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents-mobile {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 25px;
    padding: 25px 15px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode-mobile {
    margin-top: 100px;
  }
  
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents-mobile {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 20px 10px;
  }
  
  .p-home-grid-mode__item-num {
    font-size: 10px;
    left: -15px;
    top: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode-mobile {
    margin-top: 90px;
  }
  
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents-mobile {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 15px;
    padding: 15px 8px;
  }
}

/* Image Modal Styles */
.image-modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, 
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) 0%, 
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) 50%, 
    rgba(240, 240, 240, 0.9) 100%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(15px);
  z-index: 9999;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(1.1);
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

.image-modal-overlay::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 30% 20%, 
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) 0%, 
    transparent 50%
  ),
  radial-gradient(
    circle at 70% 80%, 
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) 0%, 
    transparent 50%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.image-modal-content {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 90vw;
  max-height: 90vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 80vh;
  /* Equal visual spacing top/bottom; bottom also reserves space for snackbar */
  --modal-vertical-padding: 80px; /* top visual spacing */
  --snackbar-space: 70px;        /* reserved space for snackbar */
  padding-top: var(--modal-vertical-padding);
  padding-bottom: calc(var(--modal-vertical-padding) + var(--snackbar-space));
}

.image-modal-image {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 70vh;
  object-fit: contain;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Orientation-aware caps so images don't occupy the entire page */
.image-modal-image.landscape {
  /* For wide images, prioritize width but keep reasonable height */
  max-width: 85vw;
  max-height: 60vh;
}

.image-modal-image.portrait {
  /* For tall images, prioritize height but constrain width */
  max-width: 60vw;
  max-height: 72vh;
}

.image-modal-image.square {
  max-width: 70vw;
  max-height: 70vh;
}

.image-modal-title {
  margin-top: 20px;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: #333;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 100%;
  word-wrap: break-word;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.image-modal-description {
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: #666;
  text-align: center;
  max-width: 600px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  word-wrap: break-word;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 0 20px;
}

/* Ensure metadata styles are safe by default; JS positions when space allows */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .image-metadata-left {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.3;
    color: #111;
    white-space: pre-line;
    opacity: 0.9;
    padding: 0; /* Ensure no extra padding affects spacing */
    margin: 0; /* Ensure no extra margin affects spacing */
  }
  
  /* When positioned on the side, ensure title has consistent spacing */
  .image-modal-title[style*="position: fixed"] {
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }
}

/* Navigation Snack Bar */
.image-modal-navigation {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 16px; /* place inside the reserved bottom space */
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 1px 10px; /* a bit more compact */
  background: rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.9);
  border-radius: 50px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  width: 240px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.nav-button {
  background: transparent;
  color: white;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 8px;
  width: 30px; /* further reduced */
  height: 30px; /* further reduced */
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  outline: none;
}

.nav-button:focus {
  outline: none;
  border: none;
}

.nav-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: scale(1.1) rotate(5deg);
}

.nav-button:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: scale(0.95) rotate(0deg);
  outline: none;
  border: none;
}

.nav-button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.3;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
}

.nav-close {
  background: transparent;
  font-size: 30px; /* a bit smaller */
  color: white;
  font-weight: 300;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
}

/* Ensure arrow icon images conform to reduced height */
.image-modal-navigation img {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
}

.nav-close:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: transparent;
}

/* Mobile responsive adjustments for modal */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .image-modal-overlay {
    padding: 10px;
  }
  
  .image-modal-content {
    max-width: 95vw;
    max-height: 95vh;
    min-height: 70vh;
    /* Equal top/bottom spacing on mobile */
    --modal-vertical-padding: 40px;
    --snackbar-space: 0;
    padding-top: var(--modal-vertical-padding);
    padding-bottom: var(--modal-vertical-padding);
    /* Enable smooth transitions for swipe feedback */
    transition: transform 0.1s ease-out, opacity 0.1s ease-out;
    touch-action: pan-x;
  }

  /* Swipe visual feedback */
  .image-modal-content.swiping {
    opacity: 0.8;
  }

  .image-modal-content.swipe-left {
    transform: translateX(-10px);
  }

  .image-modal-content.swipe-right {
    transform: translateX(10px);
  }

  /* Swipe indicators */
  .swipe-indicators {
    position: absolute;
    top: 20px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 10;
    opacity: 0.7;
    animation: fadeInOut 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .swipe-hint {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
    color: white;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  }

  .swipe-arrow {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: bold;
    animation: pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  .swipe-text {
    font-size: 12px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  @keyframes fadeInOut {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
    50% { opacity: 0.8; }
  }

  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.2); }
  }
  
  .image-modal-image {
    max-height: 65vh;
  }

  .image-modal-image.landscape {
    max-width: 92vw;
    max-height: 58vh;
  }
  /* revert mobile portrait override; rely on generic .image-modal-image max-height */
  .image-modal-image.square {
    max-width: 82vw;
    max-height: 66vh;
  }
  
  .image-modal-title {
    font-size: 16px;
    margin-top: 15px;
  }

  .image-modal-description {
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-top: 6px;
    padding: 0 15px;
    max-width: 90vw;
  }
  
  .image-modal-navigation {
    width: 240px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    bottom: 0px;
  }
  
  .nav-button {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    font-size: 16px;
    border-radius: 6px;
  }
  
  .nav-close {
    font-size: 32px;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .image-modal-overlay {
    padding: 5px;
  }
  
  .image-modal-content {
    max-width: 98vw;
    max-height: 98vh;
    min-height: 65vh;
    /* Equal top/bottom spacing on small mobile */
    --modal-vertical-padding: 32px;
    --snackbar-space: 0;
    padding-top: var(--modal-vertical-padding);
    padding-bottom: var(--modal-vertical-padding);
  }
  
  .image-modal-image {
    max-height: 60vh;
  }

  .image-modal-image.landscape {
    max-width: 96vw;
    max-height: 55vh;
  }
  /* revert small-mobile portrait override */
  .image-modal-image.square {
    max-width: 90vw;
    max-height: 62vh;
  }
  
  .image-modal-title {
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }

  .image-modal-description {
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-top: 5px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    max-width: 95vw;
  }
  
  .image-modal-navigation {
    width: 220px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    bottom: -20px;
  }
  
  .nav-button {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 14px;
    border-radius: 5px;
  }
  
  .nav-close {
    font-size: 36px;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  }
}

/* Main Content */
.main {
  padding-top: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Desktop-only: Dynamic height for main */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .main {
    height: auto;
  }
}

/* Grid Mode */
.p-home-grid-mode {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

/* Desktop-only: Dynamic height for grid mode */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode {
    min-height: 100vh;
    height: auto;
  }
}

.p-home-grid-mode__contents {
  width: 85%;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  row-gap: 60px;
  column-gap: 50px;
  padding: 30px 10px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  align-self: center;
  justify-self: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  align-items: center;
  transform: translateY(36%); /* Desktop: Move the grid down */
}

/* Desktop-only: Use padding instead of transform for dynamic height */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents {
    padding-top: 36vh;
    padding-bottom: 60px;
    transform: none;
    align-self: flex-start;
    align-items: start;
    height: auto;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }
}

/* Mobile responsive grid positioning */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents {
    transform: translateY(13%); /* Tablet: Less spacing */
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents {
    transform: translateY(13%); /* Mobile: Even less spacing */
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .p-home-grid-mode__contents {
    transform: translateY(13%); /* Small mobile: Minimal spacing */
  }
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
  transform: scale(1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item:hover {
  opacity: 0.8;
  transform: scale(1.02);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item-num {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #000000;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -20px;
  z-index: 2;
  letter-spacing: -0.2px;
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item-image {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item-image img {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  filter: grayscale(100%);
  transition: filter 0.3s ease;
  aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
}

/* Reduce square images by 10% - using a more specific approach */
.p-home-grid-mode__item-image.square-image img {
  width: 90%;
  height: 90%;
  top: 5%;
  left: 5%;
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item:hover .p-home-grid-mode__item-image img {
  filter: grayscale(0%);
}

/* Plus sign overlay on hover */
.p-home-grid-mode__item-image::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: #000;
  z-index: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.4s ease;
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item-image::before {
  content: "+";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: 22px;
  color: #ede9e4;
  z-index: 1;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.4s ease;
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item:hover .p-home-grid-mode__item-image::after {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.p-home-grid-mode__item:hover .p-home-grid-mode__item-image::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Left Section Container */
.p-home-left-section {
  width: 50%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  height: 100vh;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  background: #e5e7eb;
}

/* Desktop-only: Dynamic height for left section */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .p-home-left-section {
    min-height: 100vh;
    height: auto;
    overflow: visible;
    padding-bottom: 80px;
  }
}

/* Pictures Title Section */
.pictures-title-container {
  position: absolute;
  top: 12vh;
  left: 4vw;
  font-size: 3.5vw;
  line-height: 92.48%;
  display: inline-block;
  width: auto;
  min-width: 50vw;
  height: 8.376vh;
  font-family: 'PP Editorial New', serif;
  z-index: 10;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(24px);
  animation: titleFadeIn 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.4s forwards;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: none; /* Prevent touch interference */
  touch-action: none; /* Disable touch actions on this element */
}

.pictures-title {
  margin: 0;
  color: #000;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pictures-title-italic {
  font-family: 'PP Editorial New', serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-weight: 200;
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

.pictures-title-italic::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: auto;
  bottom: -4px;
  height: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.95;
  z-index: 1;
  transform-origin: left center;
  width: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: underlineGrow 1.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 1.2s forwards;
  transform: scaleX(0);
}

@keyframes underlineGrow {
  from { transform: scaleX(0); }

}

.pictures-subtitle-container {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20vh;
  left: 4vw;
  font-size: 1.2vw;

  color: #6c6a6a;

  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(20px);
  animation: subtitleFadeIn 1s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 0.8s forwards;
  pointer-events: none; /* Prevent touch interference */
  touch-action: none; /* Disable touch actions on this element */
}

  margin: 0;
}

@keyframes titleFadeIn {

    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px);
    filter: blur(2px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    filter: blur(0);
  }
}

@keyframes subtitleFadeIn {

/* Right Side Component */
.p-home-right-component {

  background: #ede9e4;
}

.p-home-right-component__image-container {
  width: 100%;

  overflow: visible;

  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);

.p-home-right-component__text {

  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;

<file src="src/styles/responsive.css">
/* Responsive layout styles */
/* Ensures the layout scales proportionally across all screen sizes */

.landing {
  /* Ensure the container scales with viewport */
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
}

/* Responsive image container */
.responsive-image-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Responsive text scaling */
.responsive-text {
  font-size: clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 24px);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/* Responsive loading title */
.responsive-loading-title {
  position: absolute;
  top: 21.7vh; /* 314px / 1440px * 100vh */
  left: 34.9vw; /* 503px / 1440px * 100vw */
  width: 36.8vw; /* 530px / 1440px * 100vw */
  height: 8.55vh; /* 171px / 2000px * 100vh */
}

/* Responsive image positioning */
.responsive-image {
  position: absolute;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.responsive-image:hover {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

/* Responsive breakpoints */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .responsive-loading-title {
    font-size: clamp(24px, 8vw, 48px);
  }
  
  .responsive-text {
    font-size: clamp(10px, 4vw, 18px);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .responsive-loading-title {
    font-size: clamp(18px, 6vw, 36px);
  }
  
  .responsive-text {
    font-size: clamp(8px, 3vw, 16px);
  }
}

/* Ensure images don't overflow on small screens */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .responsive-image {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }
}

                    <path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/>
                </svg>
            </div>

        </div>
        
        <!-- Main Content -->
        <div class="content">
            <p class="greeting">Hello,</p>

                We received a request to access your account. Please use the verification code below to complete your sign-in process.

                    Security Notice

                For your security, never share this code with anyone. Our team will never ask you for this code via phone, email, or any other method.
            </p>

            <p class="footer-text">
                This email was sent to verify your identity for secure access to your account.
            </p>
        </div>

</body>

<file src="src/utils/deferredInit.js">
/**
 * Utilities for deferring non-critical work to improve initial load performance
 */

/**
 * Defer callback execution until browser is idle
 * @param {Function} callback - Function to execute when idle
 * @param {Object} options - Options for requestIdleCallback
 */
export const deferToIdle = (callback, options = { timeout: 2000 }) => {
  if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
    requestIdleCallback(callback, options);
  } else {
    // Fallback for browsers without requestIdleCallback
    setTimeout(callback, 1);
  }
};

/**
 * Defer callback until after page load
 * @param {Function} callback - Function to execute after load
 */
export const deferToLoad = (callback) => {
  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    callback();
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('load', callback, { once: true });
  }
};

/**
 * Defer callback using requestAnimationFrame
 * Useful for visual updates that can wait
 * @param {Function} callback - Function to execute on next frame
 */
export const deferToNextFrame = (callback) => {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    requestAnimationFrame(callback);
  });
};

/**
 * Batch multiple deferred operations
 * @param {Function[]} callbacks - Array of callbacks to defer
 * @param {number} delay - Delay between each callback in ms
 */
export const batchDefer = (callbacks, delay = 100) => {
  callbacks.forEach((callback, index) => {
    setTimeout(callback, delay * index);
  });
};

export default deferToIdle;

/**
 * Image optimization utilities for better performance
 */

// Image loading with lazy loading and error handling
export const loadImageOptimized = (src, options = {}) => {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const img = new Image();
    
    // Set loading attributes for better performance
    img.loading = 'lazy';
    img.decoding = 'async';
    
    // Handle successful load
    img.onload = () => {
      resolve({
        src: img.src,
        width: img.naturalWidth,
        height: img.naturalHeight,
        aspectRatio: img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight
      });
    };
    
    // Handle load error with fallback
    img.onerror = () => {
      if (options.fallback) {
        resolve(options.fallback);
      } else {
        reject(new Error(`Failed to load image: ${src}`));
      }
    };
    
    // Start loading
    img.src = src;
  });
};

// Batch image loading with concurrency control
export const loadImagesBatch = async (imageSources, options = {}) => {
  const { concurrency = 3, fallback } = options;
  const results = [];
  
  for (let i = 0; i < imageSources.length; i += concurrency) {
    const batch = imageSources.slice(i, i + concurrency);
    const batchPromises = batch.map(src => 
      loadImageOptimized(src, { fallback }).catch(() => fallback || null)
    );
    
    const batchResults = await Promise.all(batchPromises);
    results.push(...batchResults.filter(Boolean));
  }
  
  return results;
};

// Create optimized image URLs with WebP support
export const getOptimizedImageUrl = (src, options = {}) => {
  const { width, height, quality = 80, format = 'webp' } = options;
  
  // For now, return original src - in production you'd use a CDN service
  return src;
};

// Preload critical images
export const preloadCriticalImages = (imageSources) => {
  imageSources.forEach(src => {
    const link = document.createElement('link');
    link.rel = 'preload';
    link.as = 'image';
    link.href = src;
    document.head.appendChild(link);
  });
};

// Generate placeholder for images
export const generatePlaceholder = (width, height, color = '#f0f0f0') => {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = width;
  canvas.height = height;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
  return canvas.toDataURL();
};

<file src="src/utils/performanceMonitor.js">
/**
 * Performance monitoring utilities
 */

// Monitor Core Web Vitals
export const measureCoreWebVitals = () => {
  // Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
  if ('PerformanceObserver' in window) {
    try {
      const lcpObserver = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
        const entries = list.getEntries();
        const lastEntry = entries[entries.length - 1];
        console.log('LCP:', lastEntry.startTime);
      });
      lcpObserver.observe({ entryTypes: ['largest-contentful-paint'] });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('LCP measurement failed:', e);
    }

    // First Input Delay (FID)
    try {
      const fidObserver = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
        const entries = list.getEntries();
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          console.log('FID:', entry.processingStart - entry.startTime);
        });
      });
      fidObserver.observe({ entryTypes: ['first-input'] });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('FID measurement failed:', e);
    }

    // Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
    try {
      let clsValue = 0;
      const clsObserver = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
        const entries = list.getEntries();
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.hadRecentInput) {
            clsValue += entry.value;
          }
        });
        console.log('CLS:', clsValue);
      });
      clsObserver.observe({ entryTypes: ['layout-shift'] });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('CLS measurement failed:', e);
    }
  }
};

// Monitor resource loading performance
export const measureResourcePerformance = () => {
  if ('PerformanceObserver' in window) {
    try {
      const resourceObserver = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
        const entries = list.getEntries();
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.duration > 1000) { // Log slow resources
            console.warn('Slow resource:', entry.name, entry.duration + 'ms');
          }
        });
      });
      resourceObserver.observe({ entryTypes: ['resource'] });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Resource performance measurement failed:', e);
    }
  }
};

// Monitor memory usage
export const measureMemoryUsage = () => {
  if ('memory' in performance) {
    const memory = performance.memory;
    console.log('Memory usage:', {
      used: Math.round(memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576) + ' MB',
      total: Math.round(memory.totalJSHeapSize / 1048576) + ' MB',
      limit: Math.round(memory.jsHeapSizeLimit / 1048576) + ' MB'
    });
  }
};

// Initialize performance monitoring
export const initPerformanceMonitoring = () => {
  // Only in development or when explicitly enabled
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || window.location.search.includes('perf=true')) {
    measureCoreWebVitals();
    measureResourcePerformance();
    
    // Monitor memory every 30 seconds
    setInterval(measureMemoryUsage, 30000);
  }
};

// Utility to convert hardcoded positions to responsive positions
import { responsivePosition } from './responsivePositioning.js';

/**
 * Converts a hardcoded style object to responsive positioning
 * @param {object} style - Style object with hardcoded pixel values
 * @returns {object} - Responsive style object
 */
export const convertToResponsive = (style) => {
  if (!style || typeof style !== 'object') return style;
  
  const { top, left, width, height, ...otherStyles } = style;
  
  // If it has positioning values, convert them
  if (top !== undefined && left !== undefined && width !== undefined && height !== undefined) {
    return {
      ...otherStyles,
      ...responsivePosition(
        typeof top === 'string' ? parseInt(top.replace('px', '')) : top,
        typeof left === 'string' ? parseInt(left.replace('px', '')) : left,
        typeof width === 'string' ? parseInt(width.replace('px', '')) : width,
        typeof height === 'string' ? parseInt(height.replace('px', '')) : height
      )
    };
  }
  
  return style;
};

 */

<file src="src/utils/prefetch.js">
/**
 * Route prefetching utility
 * Preloads route components before navigation for faster transitions
 */

// Map routes to their lazy component loaders
const routeMap = {
  '/': () => import('../components/Landing'),
  '/gallery': () => import('../components/Featured'),
  '/pictures': () => import('../components/FeaturedMobile'),
  '/about-us': () => import('../components/AboutUs'),
  '/about-us-mobile': () => import('../components/AboutUsMobile'),
  '/the-team': () => import('../components/TheTeamPage'),
  '/the-team-mobile': () => import('../components/the-team-mobile'),
  '/contact': () => import('../components/ContactUs'),
  '/contact-mobile': () => import('../components/ContactUsMobile'),
  '/admin': () => import('../components/Admin'),
  '/events': () => import('../components/Events'),
  '/fly': () => import('../components/Fly'),
};

// Track which routes have been prefetched
const prefetchedRoutes = new Set();

/**
 * Prefetch a route's component
 * @param {string} routePath - The route path to prefetch
 */
export const prefetchRoute = (routePath) => {
  // Don't prefetch if already done
  if (prefetchedRoutes.has(routePath)) {
    return;
  }

  const loader = routeMap[routePath];
  if (loader) {
    // Mark as prefetched immediately to avoid duplicates
    prefetchedRoutes.add(routePath);
    
    // Start loading the component
    loader().catch((err) => {
      // If prefetch fails, remove from set so it can be retried
      prefetchedRoutes.delete(routePath);
      console.warn(`Failed to prefetch route: ${routePath}`, err);
    });
  }
};

/**
 * Prefetch multiple routes at once
 * @param {string[]} routes - Array of route paths to prefetch
 */
export const prefetchRoutes = (routes) => {
  routes.forEach(route => prefetchRoute(route));
};

/**
 * Clear prefetch cache (useful for testing)
 */
export const clearPrefetchCache = () => {
  prefetchedRoutes.clear();
};

export default prefetchRoute;

<file src="src/utils/responsivePositioning.js">
// Responsive positioning utility
// Maintains exact same layout proportions across all screen sizes

// Base design dimensions (what you designed for)
const BASE_WIDTH = 1536; // Original design width
const BASE_HEIGHT = 3004; // Original design height

/**
 * Converts pixel values to responsive units that maintain the same proportions
 * @param {number} value - Pixel value from your design
 * @param {string} dimension - 'width' or 'height' for viewport scaling
 * @returns {string} - CSS value with viewport units
 */
export const responsivePx = (value, dimension = 'width') => {
  if (dimension === 'width') {
    return `${(value / BASE_WIDTH) * 100}vw`;
  } else {
    return `${(value / BASE_HEIGHT) * 100}vh`;
  }
};

/**
 * Converts pixel values to responsive units for both width and height
 * @param {number} width - Width in pixels
 * @param {number} height - Height in pixels
 * @returns {object} - Object with responsive width and height
 */
export const responsiveSize = (width, height) => ({
  width: responsivePx(width, 'width'),
  height: responsivePx(height, 'height')
});

/**
 * Converts absolute positioning to responsive positioning
 * @param {number} top - Top position in pixels
 * @param {number} left - Left position in pixels
 * @param {number} width - Width in pixels
 * @param {number} height - Height in pixels
 * @returns {object} - Object with responsive positioning styles
 */
export const responsivePosition = (top, left, width, height) => ({
  position: 'absolute',
  top: responsivePx(top, 'height'),
  left: responsivePx(left, 'width'),
  width: responsivePx(width, 'width'),
  height: responsivePx(height, 'height')
});

/**
 * Responsive font size that scales with viewport
 * @param {number} fontSize - Font size in pixels
 * @returns {string} - Responsive font size
 */
export const responsiveFontSize = (fontSize) => {
  return responsivePx(fontSize, 'width');
};

/**
 * Responsive spacing that scales with viewport
 * @param {number} spacing - Spacing in pixels
 * @returns {string} - Responsive spacing
 */
export const responsiveSpacing = (spacing) => {
  return responsivePx(spacing, 'width');
};

// Common responsive breakpoints
export const BREAKPOINTS = {
  mobile: '768px',
  tablet: '1024px',
  desktop: '1440px',
  large: '1920px'
};

// Responsive media queries
export const mediaQueries = {
  mobile: `@media (max-width: ${BREAKPOINTS.mobile})`,
  tablet: `@media (max-width: ${BREAKPOINTS.tablet})`,
  desktop: `@media (min-width: ${BREAKPOINTS.desktop})`,
  large: `@media (min-width: ${BREAKPOINTS.large})`
};

/**
 * Tutorial Manager - Handles first-time user tutorial state
 */

const TUTORIAL_KEYS = {
  MENU_FIRST_OPEN: 'exposition_exploders_menu_tutorial_shown',
  PICTURES_FIRST_VIEW: 'exposition_exploders_pictures_tutorial_shown'
};

/**
 * Check if user has seen the menu tutorial
 */
export const hasSeenMenuTutorial = () => {
  return localStorage.getItem(TUTORIAL_KEYS.MENU_FIRST_OPEN) === 'true';
};

/**
 * Mark that user has seen the menu tutorial
 */
export const markMenuTutorialSeen = () => {
  localStorage.setItem(TUTORIAL_KEYS.MENU_FIRST_OPEN, 'true');
};

/**
 * Reset tutorial state (for testing)
 */
export const resetTutorialState = () => {
  localStorage.removeItem(TUTORIAL_KEYS.MENU_FIRST_OPEN);
};

/**
 * Check if we should show tutorial (first time opening menu on desktop)
 */
export const shouldShowTutorial = () => {
  // Only show on desktop (screen width > 1024px)
  const isDesktop = window.innerWidth > 1024;
  const isFirstTime = !hasSeenMenuTutorial();
  
  return isDesktop && isFirstTime;
};

/**
 * Check if user has seen the pictures tutorial
 */
export const hasSeenPicturesTutorial = () => {
  return localStorage.getItem(TUTORIAL_KEYS.PICTURES_FIRST_VIEW) === 'true';
};

/**
 * Mark that user has seen the pictures tutorial
 */
export const markPicturesTutorialSeen = () => {
  localStorage.setItem(TUTORIAL_KEYS.PICTURES_FIRST_VIEW, 'true');
};

/**
 * Check if we should show pictures tutorial (first time viewing pictures page)
 */
export const shouldShowPicturesTutorial = () => {
  const isFirstTime = !hasSeenPicturesTutorial();
  return isFirstTime;
};

<file src="temp-files/CHATGPT_SUPABASE_BRIEF.txt">
Exposure Explorers – Product & Technical Brief for ChatGPT / Supabase Setup

Product description
Exposure Explorers is a visual-first web experience for a college photography community. It showcases curated albums, member profiles, and event highlights through immersive animations and smooth interactions. The site emphasizes high‑quality imagery, lightweight navigation, and a modern aesthetic. Visitors can browse galleries, learn about the team, and explore the club’s journey; admins can manage images, albums, tags, events, and member info via a secure workflow. The goal is to provide a polished, performant, and easily maintainable gallery platform that scales as content grows.

Project overview
- Name: Exposure Explorers website
- Tech stack:
  - React + Vite single-page app
  - React Router for client-side routing
  - GSAP + ScrollTrigger for animations and scroll pinning
  - Custom components including StaggeredMenu, Fly, TextCursorOverlay
  - Simple fetches to internal routes like /api/gallery (to be replaced with Supabase)
- Current routes/pages:
  - /            Landing
  - /our-journey Our Journey
  - /gallery and /pictures  Pictures Gallery (hover previews, right-side preview image)
  - /members     Members Page
  - /team        Team Page
  - /admin       Admin (reserved)
  - /fly         GSAP fly‑through effect
  - Mobile devices: UnderConstruction screen via useMobileDetection
- Gallery behavior:
  - On load, calls GET /api/gallery, expects { images: [{ url: string }, ...] }
  - Builds a grid of images on the left; hover swaps a large preview image on the right
  - Social links: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube
- Visual/FX highlight:
  - Fly component renders a pinned, scroll‑scrubbed 3D fly‑through of six fixed-position UI images using GSAP timelines and z-index layers

Goal for Supabase
- Replace ad-hoc /api/gallery with Supabase Postgres tables and Storage
- Store and serve images (public URLs), albums, tags, events, and team members
- Use Row Level Security (RLS) with roles (admin/editor/viewer) for safe client-side usage
- Provide minimal client code to fetch public images and render the gallery

Proposed Supabase data model
Tables
- users
  - id (uuid, pk, references auth.users)
  - username (text, unique)
  - display_name (text)
  - avatar_url (text)
  - created_at (timestamptz, default now())
- roles
  - id (serial, pk)
  - name (text, unique) — e.g., admin, editor, viewer
- user_roles
  - user_id (uuid, fk -> users.id)
  - role_id (int, fk -> roles.id)
  - primary key (user_id, role_id)
- albums
  - id (uuid, pk, default gen_random_uuid())
  - title (text)
  - description (text)
  - cover_image_id (uuid, nullable, fk -> images.id)
  - is_public (boolean, default true)
  - created_by (uuid, fk -> users.id)
  - created_at (timestamptz, default now())
  - updated_at (timestamptz, default now())
- images
  - id (uuid, pk, default gen_random_uuid())
  - storage_path (text, unique) — path inside the Storage bucket
  - public_url (text) — signed or public URL for client
  - title (text)
  - description (text)
  - width (int)
  - height (int)
  - taken_at (timestamptz, nullable)
  - uploaded_by (uuid, fk -> users.id)
  - is_public (boolean, default true)
  - created_at (timestamptz, default now())
- album_images
  - album_id (uuid, fk -> albums.id)
  - image_id (uuid, fk -> images.id)
  - position (int, default 0)
  - primary key (album_id, image_id)
- tags
  - id (serial, pk)
  - name (text, unique)
- image_tags
  - image_id (uuid, fk -> images.id)
  - tag_id (int, fk -> tags.id)
  - primary key (image_id, tag_id)
- events (optional, for “Our Journey”)
  - id (uuid, pk, default gen_random_uuid())
  - title (text)
  - description (text)
  - start_date (date)
  - end_date (date, nullable)
  - cover_image_id (uuid, nullable, fk -> images.id)
  - created_by (uuid, fk -> users.id)
  - created_at (timestamptz, default now())
- event_images (optional)
  - event_id (uuid, fk -> events.id)
  - image_id (uuid, fk -> images.id)
  - position (int, default 0)
  - primary key (event_id, image_id)
- team_members (for /team, /members)
  - id (uuid, pk, default gen_random_uuid())
  - name (text)
  - role_title (text)
  - bio (text)
  - photo_image_id (uuid, nullable, fk -> images.id)
  - order_index (int, default 0)
  - is_active (boolean, default true)
  - created_at (timestamptz, default now())

Storage
- Bucket: images (public read recommended; restrict writes/deletes via RLS/role checks)

RLS (high level)
- users/roles/user_roles: only admins can manage roles; users can read their own row
- images:
  - anon: select where is_public = true
  - authenticated: select all own uploads; insert/update/delete own rows; admins manage all
- albums:
  - anon: select where is_public = true
  - authenticated: select private if created_by = auth.uid(); admins full access
- joins (album_images, image_tags): follow parent-table policies
- team_members: anon select; only admins can modify
- events/event_images: anon select for public imagery; admin/editor manage

Minimal API shapes (frontend expectations)
- GET public gallery images → map images.public_url to { url }
- GET public albums with cover image
- GET team members ordered by order_index

Copy‑paste prompts for ChatGPT

Prompt 1: Generate SQL schema + RLS
You are a Postgres + Supabase expert. Create SQL (tables, indexes, foreign keys) and RLS policies for this app:

- Tables: users (linked to auth.users), roles, user_roles, images, albums, album_images, tags, image_tags, team_members, events, event_images (optional).
- Storage: a bucket named images for public delivery; restrict uploads to authenticated users; only admins can delete.
- Public rules: anon can select public images (images.is_public=true), public albums (albums.is_public=true), and team_members. Authenticated users can CRUD their own images and albums. Admins can manage everything.
- Include sensible defaults (timestamps, gen_random_uuid), constraints, and helpful indexes (e.g., on album_images.position, images.is_public).
- Implement RLS with policies referencing auth.uid() and a role check via a SQL function is_admin(uid uuid) that checks user_roles against the 'admin' role.

Return a single SQL block that I can run in Supabase SQL editor: schema, helper functions (is_admin), and all policies.

Prompt 2: Create Supabase client integration for the gallery
Write minimal React + Supabase JS code to replace a fetch('/api/gallery') call with a Supabase query that returns { images: [{ url }] } based on the schema:

- Select public images ordered by created_at desc, limit 50.
- Use public_url from the images table for url.
- Provide a small utility to instantiate the Supabase client using env vars (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY).
- Show a React useEffect example that loads images and sets state like: setImages(list) and setPreviewImages(list).
- Keep code concise and production-ready (error handling, no console noise).

Prompt 3: Upload pipeline to Storage and table insert
Create a TypeScript/JavaScript function that:
- Given a File object, uploads it to the 'images' bucket under a date-based path.
- On success, inserts a row into images(storage_path, public_url, title, width, height, uploaded_by, is_public).
- Generates a public URL (or signed URL if you recommend) and returns the full row.
- Include lightweight error handling and recommended content-type handling.

Prompt 4: Admin/editor role setup and policies test
Provide SQL to:
- Insert roles 'admin', 'editor', 'viewer' if missing.
- Assign 'admin' to a given user id.
- Show sample queries that demonstrate RLS: anon selects public images; authenticated user can only modify their rows; admin can modify all.
- Include a brief note on how to test policies using Supabase SQL editor with 'Run as' options or via service key.

Prompt 5: Migration plan from /api/gallery to Supabase
Outline exact steps to migrate:
1) Create tables and RLS with the provided SQL.
2) Create 'images' bucket and configure public access for reads.
3) Write a one-off script to upload existing image files to Storage and insert image rows.
4) Update frontend: replace fetch('/api/gallery') with a Supabase query to images table.
5) Remove the old /api/gallery endpoint and add a fallback empty-state in the UI.
Return a step-by-step checklist with brief commands/snippets.

<file src="temp-files/demo-looping-motion.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Enhanced Looping Motion Demo</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 20px;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            background: #f0f0f0;
        }
        .demo-container {
            max-width: 800px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: white;
            padding: 30px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
        }
        .feature-list {
            background: #f8f9fa;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            margin: 20px 0;
        }
        .feature-list h3 {
            color: #007bff;
            margin-top: 0;
        }
        .feature-list ul {
            margin: 10px 0;
            padding-left: 20px;
        }
        .feature-list li {
            margin: 8px 0;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }
        .demo-link {
            display: inline-block;
            background: #007bff;
            color: white;
            padding: 12px 24px;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin: 20px 0;
            transition: background 0.3s ease;
        }
        .demo-link:hover {
            background: #0056b3;
        }
        .code-example {
            background: #f1f3f4;
            padding: 15px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            font-family: monospace;
            margin: 15px 0;
            overflow-x: auto;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="demo-container">
        <h1>🎯 Enhanced Looping Motion Effect</h1>
        
        <p>I've enhanced your mouse follow image trail effect with <strong>automatic looping motion</strong>! Now the images move continuously in beautiful patterns while still following your mouse cursor.</p>
        
        <div class="feature-list">
            <h3>✨ New Features Added:</h3>
            <ul>
                <li><strong>Automatic Looping Motion:</strong> Images now move in continuous circular patterns</li>
                <li><strong>Staggered Animation:</strong> Each image has slightly different timing for organic movement</li>
                <li><strong>Subtle Rotation:</strong> Images gently rotate as they move</li>
                <li><strong>Enhanced Visual Effects:</strong> Drop shadows and improved button styling</li>
                <li><strong>Responsive Motion:</strong> Motion adapts to different screen sizes</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

        <h3>🔧 How the Looping Motion Works:</h3>
        <div class="code-example">
// Each image moves in a circular pattern
const loopTime = time + (col * 0.3) + (row * 0.2); // Staggered timing
const loopX = Math.sin(loopTime) * settings.loopRadius;
const loopY = Math.cos(loopTime * 0.7) * settings.loopRadius;

// Images follow mouse AND have automatic motion
const x = baseX + loopX;  // Grid position + looping motion
const y = baseY + loopY;
        </div>

        <h3>🎮 Try It Out:</h3>
        <a href="mouse-follow-effect.html" class="demo-link">🚀 Open Enhanced Demo</a>
        
        <h3>⚙️ Customization Options:</h3>
        <div class="feature-list">
            <ul>
                <li><strong>Loop Speed:</strong> Adjust <code>settings.loopSpeed</code> (default: 0.5)</li>
                <li><strong>Motion Radius:</strong> Change <code>settings.loopRadius</code> for bigger/smaller circles</li>
                <li><strong>Staggering:</strong> Modify the timing multipliers for different motion patterns</li>
                <li><strong>Rotation:</strong> Adjust the rotation amount in the animation loop</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

        <h3>🎨 What You'll See:</h3>
        <ul>
            <li>Images constantly moving in smooth circular patterns</li>
            <li>Mouse following effect still works perfectly</li>
            <li>Images scale up when close to cursor, down when far</li>
            <li>Beautiful staggered motion creates organic flow</li>
            <li>Subtle rotation adds depth and interest</li>
        </ul>

        <div class="feature-list">
            <h3>🚀 Performance Features:</h3>
            <ul>
                <li>60fps smooth animation</li>
                <li>Efficient canvas rendering</li>
                <li>Responsive design for all devices</li>
                <li>Touch device detection and optimization</li>
            </ul>
        </div>

        <p><strong>Ready to see the magic?</strong> Click the demo link above to experience the enhanced looping motion effect!</p>
    </div>
</body>
</html>

</file>

<file src="temp-files/gallery-simple.html">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="description" content="Gallery features the photos I've taken over time. I'd be glad if you could also sense the memories they hold for me.">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,minimum-scale=1,maximum-scale=5">
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="snail.svg">
    <title>Gallery</title>
    <!-- GSAP Script -->
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/gsap@3.12.2/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        
        html, body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        
        body {
            font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            background: #f2f2f2;
            color: #222222;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            overflow-y: hidden;
            position: relative;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }
        
        /* White left side background */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 50vw;
            height: 100vh;
            background: #ffffff;
            z-index: -1;
        }
        

        
        /* Header */
        .l-header {
            position: fixed;
            top: 15px;
            right:15px;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 100;
            padding: 0 40px;
        }
        
        .l-header__inner {
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding-left: 40px;
        }
        
        .l-header__name {
            font-size: 52px;
            font-weight: 400;
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-family: 'Helvetica', sans-serif;
        }
        
        .l-header__name a {
            color: #000000;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s;
        }
        
        .l-header__name a:hover {
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        
        .l-header__text {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #666666;
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.4;
            font-family: 'Helvetica', sans-serif;
        }
        
        /* StaggeredMenu Styles */
        .staggered-menu-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 40;
        }

        .staggered-menu-header {
            position: fixed;
            top: 20px;
            right: 40px;
            width: auto;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding: 0;
            background: transparent;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .staggered-menu-header > * {
            pointer-events: auto;
        }

        .sm-logo {
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            user-select: none;
        }

        .sm-logo-img {
            display: block;
            height: 32px;
            width: auto;
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        .sm-toggle {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            color: #000000;
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1;
            overflow: visible;
            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;
        }

        .sm-toggle:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid #000000aa;
            outline-offset: 4px;
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .sm-toggle:hover .sm-icon-line {
            background: #666666;
        }

        .sm-line:last-of-type {
            margin-top: 6px;
        }

        .sm-toggle-textWrap {
            position: relative;
            display: inline-block;
            height: 1em;
            overflow: hidden;
            white-space: nowrap;
            width: var(--sm-toggle-width, auto);
            min-width: var(--sm-toggle-width, auto);
        }

        .sm-toggle-textInner {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .sm-toggle-line {
            display: block;
            height: 1em;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .sm-icon {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            flex: 0 0 100%;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            will-change: transform;
        }

        .sm-panel-itemWrap {
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .sm-icon-line {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 2px;
            background: currentColor;
            border-radius: 2px;
            will-change: transform;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        
        .sm-icon-line:first-child {
            top: 6px;
        }

        .sm-icon-line:nth-child(2) {
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .sm-icon-line:last-child {
            bottom: 6px;
        }

        .sm-line {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .staggered-menu-panel {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            right: 0;
            width: clamp(260px, 38vw, 420px);
            height: 100%;
            background: white;
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 6em 2em 2em 2em;
            overflow-y: auto;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        [data-position='left'] .staggered-menu-panel {
            right: auto;
            left: 0;
        }

        .sm-prelayers {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            width: clamp(260px, 38vw, 420px);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 5;
        }

        [data-position='left'] .sm-prelayers {
            right: auto;
            left: 0;
        }

        .sm-prelayer {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        .sm-panel-inner {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1.25rem;
        }

        .sm-socials {
            margin-top: auto;
            padding-top: 2rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .sm-socials-title {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--sm-accent, #ff0000);
        }

        .sm-socials-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: row;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .sm-socials-list .sm-socials-link {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .sm-socials-list:hover .sm-socials-link {
            opacity: 0.35;
        }

        .sm-socials-list:hover .sm-socials-link:hover {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .sm-socials-link:focus-visible {
            outline: 2px solid var(--sm-accent, #ff0000);
            outline-offset: 3px;
        }

        .sm-socials-list:focus-within .sm-socials-link {
            opacity: 0.35;
        }

        .sm-socials-list:focus-within .sm-socials-link:focus-visible {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .sm-socials-link {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: #111;
            text-decoration: none;
            position: relative;
            padding: 2px 0;
            display: inline-block;
            transition:
                color 0.3s ease,
                opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .sm-socials-link:hover {
            color: var(--sm-accent, #ff0000);
        }

        .sm-panel-title {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #fff;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .sm-panel-list {
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .sm-panel-item {
            position: relative;
            color: #000;
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            line-height: 1;
            letter-spacing: -2px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            transition:
                background 0.25s,
                color 0.25s;
            display: inline-block;
            text-decoration: none;
            padding-right: 1.4em;
        }

        .staggered-menu-panel .sm-socials-list .sm-socials-link {
            opacity: 1;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .staggered-menu-panel .sm-socials-list:hover .sm-socials-link:not(:hover) {
            opacity: 0.35;
        }

        .staggered-menu-panel .sm-socials-list:focus-within .sm-socials-link:not(:focus-visible) {
            opacity: 0.35;
        }

        .staggered-menu-panel .sm-socials-list .sm-socials-link:hover,
        .staggered-menu-panel .sm-socials-list .sm-socials-link:focus-visible {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .sm-panel-itemLabel {
            display: inline-block;
            will-change: transform;
            transform-origin: 50% 100%;
        }

        .sm-panel-item:hover {
            color: var(--sm-accent, #5227ff);
        }

        .sm-panel-list[data-numbering] {
            counter-reset: smItem;
        }

        .sm-panel-list[data-numbering] .sm-panel-item::after {
            counter-increment: smItem;
            content: counter(smItem, decimal-leading-zero);
            position: absolute;
            top: 0.1em;
            right: 2.8em;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: var(--sm-accent, #5227ff);
            letter-spacing: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            user-select: none;
            opacity: var(--sm-num-opacity, 0);
        }

        @media (max-width: 1024px) {
            .staggered-menu-panel {
                width: 100%;
                left: 0;
                right: 0;
            }

            .staggered-menu-wrapper[data-open] .sm-logo-img {
                filter: invert(100%);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 640px) {
            .staggered-menu-panel {
                width: 100%;
                left: 0;
                right: 0;
            }

            .staggered-menu-wrapper[data-open] .sm-logo-img {
                filter: invert(100%);
            }
        }
        
        /* Main Content */
        .main {
            padding-top: 0;
            height: 100vh;
        }
        
        /* Grid Mode */
        .p-home-grid-mode {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 1400px;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__contents {
            width: 100%;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 120px);
            gap: 50px;
            padding: 30px;
            margin: 0;
            align-self: center;
            justify-self: center;
            justify-content: center;
            height: 100%;
            align-items: center;
            margin-left: 60px;
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            position: relative;
            transform: scale(1);
            box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item:hover {
            opacity: 0.8;
            transform: scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item-num {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #000000;
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: -20px;
            z-index: 2;
            letter-spacing: -0.2px;
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item-image {
            width: 120px;
            height: 120px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item-image img {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            filter: grayscale(100%);
            transition: filter 0.3s ease;
            aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; /* Ensure images maintain square aspect ratio */
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item:hover .p-home-grid-mode__item-image img {
            filter: grayscale(0%);
        }
        
        /* Plus sign overlay on hover */
        .p-home-grid-mode__item-image::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: #000;
            z-index: 0;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item-image::before {
            content: "+";
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            font-size: 22px;
            color: #ffffff;
            z-index: 1;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: all 0.4s ease;
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item:hover .p-home-grid-mode__item-image::after {
            opacity: 0.7;
        }
        
        .p-home-grid-mode__item:hover .p-home-grid-mode__item-image::before {
            opacity: 1;
        }
        
        /* Loading Page */
        .c-loading-page {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: #ffffff;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            z-index: 2000;
            transition: opacity 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
            will-change: opacity;
        }
        
        .c-loading-page__content {
            text-align: center;
        }
        

        
        .c-loading-page__text {
            font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            font-size: 72px;
            font-weight: 400;
            letter-spacing: normal;
            opacity: 1; /* parent visible; letters animate individually */
            transform: none;
            visibility: hidden; /* prevent full word flash before JS split */
        }

        /* Per-letter animation for loading title */
        .char {
            display: inline-block;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(12px);
            animation: charIn 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
        }

        @keyframes charIn {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        
        /* Left Section Container */
        .p-home-left-section {
            width: 50%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: flex-start;
            padding: 0;
            height: 100vh;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        
        /* New Right Side Component */
        .p-home-right-component {
            width: 50%;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;
            height: 100vh;
            padding-left: 0; /* remove padding so centering works */
            overflow: visible; /* allow image to breathe; avoid clipping */
            position: relative;
            margin-left: auto;
            text-align: center;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        
        .p-home-right-component__image-container {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 500px;
            position: relative;
            overflow: visible; /* don't clip image */
            margin-bottom: 80px;
            
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 300px;
            max-height: calc(100vh - 200px); /* restore cap for tall images */
            flex: 1;
            margin: 0 auto;
            margin-left: 180px; /* compensate for removed container padding */
        }
        
        .p-home-right-component__image-container img {
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: calc(100vh - 300px); /* restore cap */
            object-fit: contain; /* preserve aspect */
            transition: all 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }
        
        .p-home-right-component__text {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            font-size: 32px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: #000000;
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 60px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%); /* center within right half */
            z-index: 100;
            margin-left: 83px; /* nudge 20px to the right */
            font-family: 'Helvetica', sans-serif;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: textFadeIn 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 400ms forwards;
        }

        @keyframes textFadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; filter: blur(2px); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(6px); }
            to { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .c-loading-page__text,
            .p-home-right-component__text {
                animation: none;
                opacity: 1;
                transform: none;
            }
        }
        
        .p-home-right-component__text .line {
            width: 80px;
            height: 2px;
            background: #000000;
        }
        
        /* View Toggle */
        .p-home-view {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 40px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            display: flex;
            background: #000000b3;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border: 1px solid #555;
            border-radius: 100vmax;
            padding: 3px;
            gap: 10px;
            z-index: 100;
            position: relative;
        }
        
        .p-home-view__button {
            min-width: 50px;
            height: 26px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 100vmax;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 600;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.4s;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }
        
        .p-home-view__button:hover {
            opacity: 0.5;
        }
        
        .p-home-view__button.is-current {
            color: #222222;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        
        .p-home-view__background {
            position: absolute;
            width: 50px;
            height: 26px;
            background: #ffffff;
            border-radius: 100vmax;
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
            z-index: 0;
        }
        
        .p-home-view__background[data-view="grid"] {
            transform: translateX(0);
        }
        
        .p-home-view__background[data-view="slider"] {
            transform: translateX(100%);
        }
        

        

        
        /* Mobile Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 767px) {
            .l-header { padding: 0 20px; top: 20px; }
            .l-menu-button { top: 20px; right: 20px; }
            .p-home-grid-mode { flex-direction: column; padding: 0 20px; }
            .p-home-grid-mode__contents {
                width: 100%;
                grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
                gap: 30px;
                padding: 40px;
                margin-bottom: 40px;
                max-width: 500px;
            }
            .p-home-right-component { 
                width: 100%; 
                padding: 20px; 
            }
            .p-home-right-component__image-container { 
                height: 300px; 
                margin-bottom: 80px;
                max-height: 300px;
            }
            .p-home-right-component__text {
                bottom: 60px;
                font-size: 28px;
                font-family: 'Helvetica', sans-serif;
            }
            .p-home-view { bottom: 20px; }
        }
        
        /* Ensure proper spacing for portrait images */
        @media (min-height: 800px) {
            .p-home-grid-mode__area-image {
                max-height: calc(100vh - 250px);
            }
            .p-home-grid-mode__area-text {
                bottom: 140px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
